from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Q1FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for a single company from one document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the listed company")
    stock_code: str = Field(description="Stock code for unique identification")
    period: str = Field(description="Reporting period covered by the financial data")
    net_profit: float = Field(description="Net profit attributable to shareholders; negative for loss")
    quote: str = Field(description="Source text containing the profit figure for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    records: list[Q1FinancialRecord]
